Discovery brief: An analytics dashboard product (greenfield).

Goal: a SaaS dashboard that ingests events and renders charts.

Capabilities: (1) Ingestion — receive events over an HTTP API and store them. (2) Querying — aggregate stored events into time-series. (3) Dashboards — render the aggregates as charts on a web UI.

First slice: ingest events and show a single hard-coded chart (ingestion + a minimal query + one chart).

Dependencies: querying depends on ingestion; dashboards depend on querying.
